features.name: AST API Extraction
features.description: Parses Python source with the stdlib ast module and extracts modules, classes, functions, parameters, type hints and decorators without importing the code.

features.name: Drift Detection
features.description: The --check mode regenerates every document into a temporary directory and diffs it against docs/, exiting non-zero when committed docs are stale.

features.name: Benchmark Harness
features.description: Measures generation wall-clock time, output size and docstring coverage against pdoc and sphinx-apidoc, writing real measured numbers to benchmarks/results.json.
